findings.finding: Claim under doubt: Adding the 8 _keystone_*.py files + their entry point to SENSITIVE_PATH_RE fully closes trg-9967000f's parity gap for the keystone gate's verifier logic. — Traced the import graph: check_keystone_ac_gate.py and the _keystone_*.py modules import several shared verifiers/ helpers (e.g. layer-coverage severity and merge-base resolution logic) that are NOT _keystone_-prefixed, so an edit to those shared helpers is not caught by the new patterns even though the logic they carry is keystone-specific in effect. Those same helpers also back a separate, unrelated non-keystone gate, so widening the match to their directory would over-broaden mandatory review onto that other gate's unrelated maintenance PRs -- a real trade-off, not a drop-in fix.
findings.suggestion: Addressed: documented the residual gap directly in the SENSITIVE_PATH_RE comment and filed follow-up triage card trg-a719e3b7 naming the two remediation directions (split the keystone-specific call paths into _keystone_-prefixed wrappers, or formally accept the structural limit of a file-path-only detector). Deliberately deferred rather than folded into this run, matching how the original keystone-gate design doc deferred this whole family of follow-ups.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: The two new SENSITIVE_PATH_RE alternatives could be under-inclusive (miss files they should cover) due to lacking a trailing anchor. — Neither is end-anchored, but re.match only pins the start -- the effect is over-inclusive (e.g. a stray non-.py file under the matched prefix would also trigger review), never under-inclusive. Forces more review, never less, and matches this file's pre-existing style for every other directory-style alternative. No action needed.

Claim under doubt: The fix could silently fail to match at runtime due to Windows path separators, git core.quotePath, or encoding differences between how paths are diffed locally vs. how CI evaluates them. — Read pr-review-run.yml directly: changed paths come from `gh api .../pulls/$PR_NUMBER/files`, always forward-slash and case-exact to the stored repo path -- the PR head is never locally checked out, so there is no core.quotePath step and no Windows separator in this pipeline. Disproven.

Claim under doubt: check_keystone_ac_gate.py is correctly identified as the file ci.yml's keystone step actually invokes. — Read .github/workflows/ci.yml directly rather than trusting the description: the 'Keystone AC gate (gate)' step runs `uv run shared/scripts/tools/check_keystone_ac_gate.py --project-root . --head-sha ...`, matching the new pattern exactly. Confirmed correct.

Claim under doubt: GitHub's changed-file-list truncation could be exploited to hide one of the new keystone paths from SENSITIVE_PATH_RE. — decide() checks the `sensitive_path_list_truncated` sentinel unconditionally before ever reaching SENSITIVE_PATH_RE, and that fail-closed behavior is pre-existing and generic -- the new alternatives introduce no new manipulation surface here. Disproven.
